Messages.Author: Rehlow
Messages.Body:
Now that I have 7 Hag's Wrinkles I've been thinking about some silly
deck ideas with Reg doing lots of equipping for his friends and
untapping afterwards with Hag's Wrinkles. I want to see if all my
assumptions are correct.

1) Reg equips a Camera Phone and gives it away to someone else and Reg
untaps (Hag's Wrinkles/Freak Drive). The new owner of the Camera Phone
bleeds. Now Reg wants to equip a piece of equipment on a minion, the
Camera Phone, and give it to someone else, with his special. I can do
all of this in the same turn and not run into NRA because

a) a card played from hand is different than from one in play (frex.
playing Clandestine Contract, untapping, and using its enter combat
text all in the same turn) and/or

b) equipping from a minion is like rescuing or diablerizing a vampire
in torpor and is not limited by NRA (this would allow Reg to continue
to move the Camera Phone around in a single turn provided he can keep
untapping).

2) If Reg goes to take equipment from a minion in play and the target
has more than one piece of equipment, can Reg

a) give all of it away to only 1 other ready minion?

b) give 1 item to minion A and 1 item to minion B?

c) give 1 item to minion A and keep 1 item for himself?

Thanks,
~Rehlow

Reg Driscoll
Samedi, 8 Cap
OBF THAN for pre aus
Independent: If Reg performs a successful equip action, you may move
the equipment to any ready minion you control. +1 bleed.
